title: Synergy Team Site and Video Express for Baseball
description: Learners gain the skills to log in to Team Site, read the Upload Schedule and manage team users, then install Video Express and upload pitch charts and multi-angle game video. They also learn to monitor uploads from the Transfer Status page.

modules.title: Team Site for Baseball
modules.summary: Log in to Team Site, read the Upload Schedule to see upload duties and logging progress, and manage Staff and Player accounts as a Team Admin.
learning_objectives: Learners will be able to reach the Team Site login page from the Baseball App or directly
Learners will be able to filter the Upload Schedule and interpret its Type, upload and Progress columns
Learners will be able to add a Staff or Player user and grant administrator access
Learners will be able to send password resets or deactivate users from the Users tab
modules.content:
## Team Site For Baseball: Getting Started On Team Site you are able to manage user accounts, determine who is responsible for uploading a game, and navigate Synergy's knowledge base. The following article will walk you through logging in on Team Site. ### Logging In There are two ways to navigate to the Team Site login page: **1. If you are in the Baseball App you can click on Upload or Admin in the Settings Menu.** ![Screenshot: Team Site For Baseball: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565359-01.jpg) 2. **Or you can use the following link to go straight to the Team Site login:** [**https://baseball-web.synergysports.com/**](https://baseball-web.synergysports.com/) Once you get to the Team Site login page, you will need to sign in using your Synergy Sports credentials. ![Screenshot: Team Site For Baseball: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565359-02.jpg) After logging in, you will be able to access the following Team Site resources: - Upload Schedule tab (see the “Team Site for Baseball” lesson): this shows whether your team is responsible for uploading a game. You can also check the logging progress for each game. - Users tab: (see the “Team Site for Baseball” lesson)Manage your team’s Staff and Player Accounts (only Team Admins have this access). - User Menu: Access the support guide, an online knowledge base with training videos, and helpful articles. ![Screenshot: Team Site For Baseball: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565359-03.jpg) ### ### User Menu Clicking on the User Profile icon will bring up the User Menu. ![Screenshot: Team Site For Baseball: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565359-04.jpg) The User Menu will give you access to the Support Page and Download Links. The Support Page is where you can access the content guides for baseball. Download Links is where you can find the link and directions for downloading the Synergy Baseball App. ## Team Site for Baseball: Upload Schedule The Upload Schedule shows whether or not your team is responsible for uploading a game, and it shows the logging progress for each game. The Upload Schedule is constantly updated, so check your team’s schedule prior to each game. ### Upload Schedule Select the **Upload Schedule** tab, and use the League, Season, Division, and Team filters to filter down to a specific team's schedule. ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Upload Schedule](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565358-01.jpg) Once you've filtered down to a specific team, you will see the team's upload schedule. #### ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Upload Schedule](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565358-02.jpg) ### Upload Schedule Breakdown
Date

Game date.

Opponent

Displays the opponent for the game.

  • Clicking on an opponent’s team name will jump to that team's schedule.
Type
  • Stream (Synergy Capture): No upload required.
  • Stream (Upload Required): An upload is required.
  • Upload: The game requires an upload so Synergy can break down the game.
  • TV: The game will be captured from TV and does not require an upload.
Uploaded CF & Uploaded Home Plate

Indicates the status of an upload attempt.

  • Blank: No upload attempt.
  • : A successful upload attempt has been recorded; raw video is now available for download in Video Express.
Away Team Pitch Chart & Home Team Pitch Chart

Indicates whether Synergy has received the Pitch Chart.

  • Blank: No upload attempt.
  • : A successful upload attempt has been recorded.
Progress

Displays the logging status of the game.

  • Blank: The game has not been captured from TV or uploaded to Synergy. No work is currently being done on the game.
  • In Progress: Synergy has the video and is working on the game.
  • Complete: All logging and breakdowns have been completed. All videos and stats are now available for this game.
CompetitionRegular Season, Playoffs, Spring Training, etc. (may vary by League).
CommentDisplays additional notes and information about this game. If time is missing from the source of a game it will be noted in this section.
## Team Site for Baseball: Manage Users As the Team Admin, you have access and responsibility to handle your team's Synergy accounts. You can add new users, send password resets, reactivate or deactivate existing users, and even send emails from the Users Tab. ### Manage Users Select the **Users** tab from the Team Site to access all of the users for your team's subscription. ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Manage Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565360-01.jpg) Once you have selected the Users tab, you can use the User Management filters on the left to filter by user status, user type, and name or expiration date. ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Manage Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565360-02.jpg) #### #### Add Users To add a new user, select **+Add**. ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Manage Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565360-03.jpg) After selecting +Add you can create Staff and Player accounts. You can enter the Name, Title, E-Mail, and Phone Number of the new User. If you are adding a Staff member whom you wish to have administrator access to your Synergy account, toggle the Administrator button to Yes. ![Screenshot: Team Site for Baseball: Manage Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565360-04.jpg) Once all fields have been filled, select **Add User**at the bottom, and the account will be created and a welcome email will be automatically generated with instructions for the user on how to set up their password for their Synergy account. #### Manage User Accounts To send password resets, reactivate or deactivate existing users, or email users, you must first select a user or multiple users. To do this, you can click on a user that is listed or select multiple users by marking the checkboxes in the upper right of the user squares. Once the users have been selected, the send password reset, reactivate users, deactivate users, and email users options will become available. If you experience any issues or difficulties with your user management, please reach out to our Support Team at [support@synergysports.com](mailto:support@synergysports.com) or call 1-800-411-1627.

modules.title: Video Express: Requirements and Installation
modules.summary: Check that your computer, bandwidth and Documents folder meet Video Express requirements, then install the app on PC or Mac and log in.
learning_objectives: Learners will be able to check a computer against the minimum and recommended requirements
Learners will be able to identify the video and file formats Synergy accepts
Learners will be able to set up a Documents folder with enough space and permissions
Learners will be able to install Video Express on a PC or a Mac
modules.content:
## Video Express for Baseball: Minimum and Recommended Requirements

#### Minimum requirements

- PC
  - Operating System: Windows 7 (64-bit)

Note: Microsoft has stopped supporting this version of Windows, and it is not compatible with other Synergy applications. Continued use may cause performance issues.

- - Processor: Dual Core 2.0GHz or equivalent – 2013 and later
  - RAM: 4 GB
  - Graphics: NVIDIA Ti 4800 or ATI 9800 or equivalent
  - Hard Drive: 10 GB of free hard drive space
  - Documents folder that is on the hard drive (not networked with limitations)
- MAC
  - macOS High Sierra 10.14 or later
  - Intel quad-core i3 processor or greater
    - At least 3GHz
  - 8 GB RAM or greater
  - 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
  - Discrete graphics card

#### Recommended Requirements

Synergy recommends the following specifications (specifically for running Editor 7 and Source Manager 5 with local capture and advanced editing workflows). If you are purchasing a new Mac computer, a quad-core processor and a discrete graphics card are essential;  for Windows, a multi-core processor is essential. Increased RAM, at or greater than the recommended configuration below, and sufficient hard disk space or video backup storage, are the next most important options to consider for capture and editing workflows.

- Mac
  - macOS High Sierra 10.13 or later
  - Intel quad-core i7 processor or greater
  - At least 2.3 GHz before Turbo Boost
  - 16 GB RAM or greater
  - 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
  - Discrete graphics card
- Windows
  - Windows 10 (64-bit)
  - Intel quad-core i7 CPU or greater
    - At least 2.5 GHz before Turbo Boost

Note: AMD processors, equivalent to the quad-core Intel i7, should also provide good performance

- - 16 GB RAM or greater
  - 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
  - Discrete graphics card

Internet Bandwidth Requirements

- For the smoothest video playback, it is recommended, though not required, that teams have 5-10 MBPS of upload and download bandwidth available on campus.
- Because of the large size of game video files, we recommend upload speeds of 5+ Mbps to ensure games are uploaded in a timely fashion.

#### Required Video and File Formats

- Teams must provide video files for every game unless the game is broadcast or a Synergy-captured live webstream.
  - For games not captured by Synergy, the following formats can be uploaded to Synergy for breakdown: .MP4, .AVI, .WMV, .MOV, .MPG, .MOD, .MTS, .VOB, etc.
- Teams must provide Synergy with Roster, Box Score and Pitch Charts including pitch type, location, and velocity.
  - Synergy allows the following file types: .HTML, .XML, .CSV, .PDF, .PNG, .JPEG, etc.

#### Documents Folder Setup

- Synergy files are written to either the Documents folder on your computer’s hard drive (not networked with limitations).
- The Documents folder should be at least 25 GB of available disk space.
- You must also have Read/Write permissions on the specified Documents folder.

## Video Express for Baseball: Installation Links and Getting Started

### Overview

The Synergy Sports Video Express is a standalone application used to upload game video files and pitch charts to the Synergy servers for analysis and logging. In addition to uploading your game film and charts, you can also upload and save non-game files for storage or sharing among your team and staff.

Note: Non-Game uploads are ONLY visible to your team and/or staff.

### Installation for PC users

1. Click on the link below to go to the Video Express download page:

<https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/videoexpress/>

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Installation Links and Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570481-01.jpg)

2. After you navigate to the Video Express download page, click the **Install** button

3. Open the downloaded file

4. If asked, click **Run**and complete the on-screen prompts

5. After installing, the program will open and prompt you to log in

### Installation for Mac users

1. Click on the link below to download the Video Express app:

<https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/videoexpress/>

2. Open the downloaded file

3. Click and drag the **Video Express** icon into the Applications folder icon

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Installation Links and Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570481-02.gif)

4. Open **Video Express** from your computer's Applications folder, and then log in.

options: 5-10 Mbps upload and download, with upload speeds of 5+ Mbps
questions.explanation: Synergy recommends 5-10 Mbps up and down, and 5+ Mbps upload for timely uploads.

questions.question: You are installing Video Express on a Mac. What do you do after opening the downloaded file?
options: Click Run and complete the prompts
Drag the Video Express icon into the Applications folder icon
Log in on the download page

modules.title: Video Express: Quick Start
modules.summary: Follow the Quick Start steps to upload a pitch chart and then game video, and choose camera angles and Rip Directory settings along the way.
learning_objectives: Learners will be able to start an upload from the Quick Start page
Learners will be able to select the correct game using the Year, League and Team menus
Learners will be able to set camera angles and sources for a video upload
Learners will be able to explain why pitch charts are uploaded before video
modules.content:
## Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide

Synergy Video Express for Baseball is a dynamic file delivery system that allows Synergy to receive multiple angles of game film for each game, along with their supporting documentation, necessary for logging and creating detailed clips for use with other Synergy products such as the  [Synergy Baseball app](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/sections/360013361271-Synergy-Baseball) and [Synergy Editor](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/sections/360013248152-Synergy-Editor-MAX-Editor)[.](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/articles/360008219091)

### Quick Start Guide: Uploading Games to Video Express

Below are the steps for making a successful upload using the Video Express application.

1. Log into Video Express

2. Select **Start Upload** from the Video Express Quick Start page

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-01.jpg)

3. Select **Pitch Chart Upload**

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-02.jpg)

4. Once a new upload is initiated, select the game you would like to upload your file to using the dropdown menus in the upper right.

- Year
- League
- Team

5. After making your selection, click to highlight the game you would like to upload your files to and click **Upload** in the lower right.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-03.jpg)

6. Use the Video Express Upload Instructions as a guide or select **Do Not Show This Message Again** in the lower left.

7. Browse to the location of the file you wish to upload, select the file(s), and click **Continue**to proceed.

You will be redirected to the Video Express Transfer Status page, where you can monitor the upload progress.

8. Begin Video Upload: Select **New Upload**from the Video Express Transfer Status page.

**
![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-04.jpg)**

9. Select **Video Upload**

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-05.jpg)

10. Once a new upload is initiated, select the game you would like to upload video for using the dropdown menus in the upper right.

- Year
- League
- Team

11. After making your selection, click to highlight the game you would like to upload your film to and click **Upload**in the lower right.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-06.jpg)

12. Select the number of Camera Angles. From the Video Express Quality Selector / Comments page, select the number of camera angles you wish to upload by using the Total Camera Angles dropdown menu.

13. Use the dropdown menu in each Camera Angle box to select the angle and Source (TV or Non-TV)

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-07.jpg)

14. Add Video Files by clicking the **+** button to the right of the Add Video File(s) field for each Camera Angle. When prompted, browse to the file location on your computer and select the video you wish to upload. If you have multiple files for a specific camera angle, please be sure to include all the files (preferably selected in the correct sequential order) at the same time by using one of the multi-select methods appropriate for your computer, or add them sequentially, one at a time to the appropriate Camera Angle.

*Note: Ideally, it is best to keep the number of files uploaded per angle to the minimum amount possible. Uploading under 10 files per angle will help to manage any space issues you may encounter on your computer locally which could affect the ability to upload.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-08.jpg)

If you need to remove a file prior to starting the upload, use the red “X” in the Delete File column.

15. Adjust Rip Directory Settings. By default, the Rip Directory is turned off. Click the **Gear**Icon to the right above the Camera Angle to open the Rip Directory Settings window.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Guide](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570485-09.jpg)

Use the settings to redirect the Rip file to a location that may provide more sufficient storage space if necessary. Setting options available are:

- ... : Used to browse to the location you would like to select the Rip file to relocate to
- Reset: Used to reset the Rip file location to the application default
- OK: used to proceed with the current selection
- Cancel: Cancels the selection process and leaves current settings in place

Once the upload is complete, the temporary Rip file is removed from the Uploads folder and the storage space it used is recovered.

16. Continue by selecting the Continue or Cancel button in the lower right. Selecting Continue will begin the upload process, Cancel will return you to the Transfer Status Page and cancel the previous selections.  Once the upload process has begun, monitor the progress from the Video Express Quality Selector / Comments page for each file/angle or from the Transfer Status Page.

## Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Page

When first opening Video Express, you are directed to the Quick Start Page, as seen below. From here, you can choose to start an upload, or continue on to the Transfer Status page.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quick Start Page](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570486-01.jpg)

There are two options displayed on the Quick Start page:

- **Start Upload:**Used to initiate all new uploads of Game film and Pitch Charts
  - *Note:It is important that the Pitch Charts be uploaded first, prior to beginning your video upload. Having this documentation in place prior to the video upload enables a smoother, quicker, and accurate logging process
- **Transfer Status**: Used to manage uploads that have been to Synergy

questions.question: You have both a pitch chart and game video for the same game. Which should you upload first, and why?
options: Video, so logging can begin sooner
Either one; the order has no effect
Pitch chart, because having it in place first makes logging smoother, quicker and accurate
Video, because the pitch chart is optional
questions.explanation: Pitch charts should be uploaded first because they enable a smoother, quicker and more accurate logging process.

questions.question: You opened Video Express and want to send a new game. Which Quick Start page option do you choose?
questions.explanation: Start Upload initiates all new uploads of game film and pitch charts.

questions.question: After choosing Pitch Chart Upload you need to find the right game. What do you use?
options: The Year, League and Team dropdown menus in the upper right
questions.explanation: Dropdown menus for Year, League and Team in the upper right narrow the list of games.

questions.question: You selected the wrong video file before starting the upload. How do you remove it?
options: Select Cancel after the upload starts
Use the red X in the Delete File column
questions.explanation: Before the upload starts, the red X in the Delete File column removes a file.

questions.question: Your computer is low on storage for an upload. What Rip Directory option helps?
options: Click Continue to skip the Rip file
Turn on the Rip Directory in the Gear icon settings and redirect the Rip file to a location with more space
questions.explanation: The Gear icon's Rip Directory Settings let you redirect the Rip file to a location with more storage.

modules.title: Video Express: Uploading Video

modules.content:
## Video Express for Baseball: Starting a Video Upload

To upload your game to Synergy, select **Start Upload** from the Quick Start page or select **New Upload** from the Transfer Status page. This will take you to the Video Express Upload page, where you will see two options:

1. Pitch Chart Upload
2. Video Upload

#### Video Upload

Video Upload initiates the process for uploading game video to Synergy.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Starting a Video Upload](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570490-01.jpg)

Once a new upload is initiated, you will select the game you would like to upload video for using the dropdown menus in the upper right.

- Year
- League
- Team

After making your selection, click to highlight the game you would like to upload your film to.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Starting a Video Upload](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570490-02.jpg)

The last three columns on the table will indicate the status of any game uploads:

- Upload Complete Data File
  - Displays a green check mark if Pitch Charts have been uploaded for this game
- Upload Complete CF
  - Displays a green check mark if "Broadcast" and "CF Camera Angles" have been uploaded for this game
- Upload Complete Home Plate
  - Displays a green check mark if"Low Home and "High Home" Camera Angles have been uploaded for this game.
  - *Note: additional Camera Angles can be selected during the upload process.  These include: "LHP Open," "RHH Open," "RHP Open," "LHH Open," etc.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Starting a Video Upload](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570490-03.jpg)

## Video Express for Baseball: Accepted Video Formats for Uploads

#### Accepted Video Formats

- .vob
- .mp4
- .avi
- .wmv
- .mov
- .m4v
- .mpg
- .mod
- .mts

## Video Express for Baseball: Adding a Video File to Upload

Select Video Files by clicking the **+** button to the right of the **Add Video File(s)** field for each Camera Angle.  When prompted, browse to the file location on your computer and select the video you wish to upload. If you have multiple files for a specific camera angle, please be sure to include all the files (preferably selected in the correct sequential order) at the same time by using one of the multi-select methods appropriate for your computer, or add them sequentially, one at a time to the appropriate Camera Angle.

*Note: Ideally, it is best to keep the number of files uploaded per angle to the minimum amount possible. Uploading under 10 files per angle will help to manage any space issues you may encounter on your computer locally which could affect the ability to upload.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Adding a Video File to Upload](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570492-01.jpg)

Video files can only be added during this stage.  Once started, you cannot add more video files to the current upload.  Should you need to remove a file prior to upload, select the red **X** from the **Delete File** column to the right of the file name you wish to delete.

*Note: If you upload an incorrect video file, please attempt a new upload and attach the correct video files along with notifying Synergy as to which video files are correct for that game.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Adding a Video File to Upload](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570492-02.jpg)

Use the  **Continue**or **Cancel**button in the lower right to proceed. Selecting **Continue**will begin the  Upload process, **Cancel**will return you to the Transfer Status page and cancel the previous selections.

## Video Express for Baseball: Selecting Camera Angles and Files for Upload

Video Express now allows you to upload Multi-Angle video from a variety of camera angles, which translates into more detail and depth of analysis possible with our other Softball products.

From the Video Express Quality Selector / Comments page, select the number of camera angles you wish to upload by using the **Total Camera Angles** dropdown menu.  (Note: Once selected, the application will remember the setting for subsequent uploads.  If at any time you wish to change this, simply reselect the number of Camera Angles from the dropdown menu).

*Note: For the most accurate data, Synergy strongly recommends uploading CF for Camera Angle 1

When selecting only one camera angle. (not recommended), select from the options below:

- CF
- Broadcast
- Low Home

When selecting two camera angles, select from the options below:

 Camera Angle 1

- CF
- Broadcast

Camera Angle 2:

- High Home
- Low Home

When selecting three or more camera angles. Select from the options below:

 Camera Angle 1 options:

- CF
- Broadcast

Camera Angle 2 options:

- High Home (Default, preferred angle for video/data on Fielding, Throwing, and Baserunning Reports)
- Low Home - Secondary angle (only if High Home not available) for video/data on Fielding, Throwing, and Baserunning Report

Camera Angles 3-6 options:

- LHP Open
- RHH Open
- RHP Open
- LHH Open

**Source**

You must also identify the source of the video using the Source dropdown menu. Select from:

- **TV**
- **Non-TV**

## Video Express for Baseball: Quality Selector/Comments Page and Rip Video

#####

##### **Rip Video**

Selecting the gear icon in the upper right of the Video Express Quality Selector/Comments page will open the Rip Directory Settings. By default, the Rip Directory is turned off. If switched on, you will be able to make a selection to redirect the Rip Video location for your upload.

During the upload process, Video Express makes a temporary duplicate file of those selected for upload. It is imperative that the computer or selected storage location has enough space to accommodate both the original file and its duplicate (for example, if you are uploading a 3GB file, you need a minimum of 6GB available to make the upload).  **Without enough space, the upload will fail.**

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quality Selector/Comments Page and Rip Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570494-01.jpg)

Typically, Video Express will write these files to the default location located locally in your computer's Documents folder (Typically located in: /User/Username/Documents/VideoExpress/Upload, or similar location depending on the platform), however, using the page settings shown above, you are able to redirect the Rip file to another location that may provide more sufficient storage space if necessary.

Setting options available are:

- **...** : Used to browse to the location you would like to select the Rip file to relocate to
- **Reset**: Used to reset the Rip file location to the application default
- **OK**: used to proceed with the current selection
- **Cancel**: Cancels the selection process and leaves current settings in place

Once the upload is complete, the temporary Rip file is removed from the Uploads folder and the storage space it used is recovered.

##### **Comments Section**

You are encouraged to use the Comments section to communicate any important details about uploaded files. For instance, if you plan to upload additional camera angles, missing video, or higher-quality videos at a later time.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Quality Selector/Comments Page and Rip Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570494-02.jpg)

questions.question: In the game list, the Upload Complete CF column shows a green check mark. What has been uploaded?
options: Low Home and High Home camera angles
questions.explanation: Upload Complete CF shows a green check when Broadcast and CF camera angles have been uploaded.

questions.question: You are uploading two camera angles. Which pairing matches the options?
options: Angle 1: Low Home; Angle 2: RHH Open
Angle 1: CF or Broadcast; Angle 2: High Home or Low Home
questions.explanation: With two angles, Angle 1 is CF or Broadcast and Angle 2 is High Home or Low Home.

questions.question: You upload three or more angles. For the Fielding, Throwing and Baserunning Reports, which is the default, preferred Angle 2?
questions.explanation: High Home is the default, preferred angle for those reports; Low Home is the secondary angle.

questions.question: You are choosing Camera Angle 1 for the most accurate data. Which does Synergy strongly recommend?
questions.explanation: Synergy strongly recommends uploading CF for Camera Angle 1.

questions.question: You are about to upload a 3 GB video file. How much free space do you need?
questions.explanation: Video Express makes a temporary duplicate of the file, so you need room for both: 6 GB for a 3 GB file.

questions.question: You forgot a file and realize this after the upload has started. What can you do?
options: Add the file to the current upload
Start a new upload with the correct files and notify Synergy which files are correct
Change the Total Camera Angles menu
questions.explanation: Video files can only be added before the upload starts; start a new upload and tell Synergy which files are correct.

questions.question: You plan to upload a better-quality video later. Where should you tell Synergy?
questions.explanation: The Comments section communicates details such as additional angles, missing video or higher-quality video coming later.

questions.question: Each video you upload needs a source label. What choices does the Source dropdown offer?
questions.explanation: The Source dropdown offers TV and Non-TV.

modules.content:
## Video Express for Baseball: Uploading Pitch Charts

To upload your Pitch Chart to Synergy, select **Start Upload**from the Quick Start page or select **New Upload**from the Transfer Status page. This will take you to the Video Express Upload page, where you will see two options:

1. Pitch Chart Upload
2. Video Upload

*Note: It is important that the Pitch Charts be uploaded first, prior to beginning your video upload. Having this documentation in place prior to the video upload enables a smoother, quicker, and accurate logging process

Pitch Chart Upload

Uploading the supporting documentation for game film is vital to accurate logging and the overall value of all of the Synergy Baseball products.

Pitch Chart Upload initiates the process for uploading game video to Synergy.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Uploading Pitch Charts](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570488-01.jpg)

Once a new upload is initiated, you will select the game you would like to upload to using the dropdown menus in the upper right.

- **Year**
- **League**
- **Team**

After making your selection, click to highlight the game you would like to upload your files to and select **Upload** from the lower right. The **U****pload Complete Data File**column will display a green check mark if a Pitch Chart has been uploaded to a game.

![Screenshot: Video Express for Baseball: Uploading Pitch Charts](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570488-02.jpg)

You will see the Video Express Upload Instruction page.  Feel free to select the **Do not show this message again** box to skip this page on subsequent uploads. Select **Continue** from the lower right to proceed with your upload.

Next, you will browse to the location of the file you wish to upload. Select the file, click **OK** and continue to the Transfer Status page to monitor the progress of your upload.

- Accepted file types for **Pitch Charts** are:
  - HTML, PDF, CSV, XLSX, PNG, JPEG, JSON, XML

## Video Express for Baseball: Navigating the Transfer Status page

The Transfer Status page provides a variety of information regarding the details and progress of an upload.  Access all of the application's features, as well as monitor the progress of active, or previous uploads.

**Select features such as:**

- **New Upload**: Begins new upload process for video or file selection
- **Remove:** Removes active or previous uploads from the queue
  - Note: to remove an upload, click the line of the item you would like to remove, then the **Remove** button will become active
- **Gear Icon:** The Video Express application settings can be found here.  Choose from options such as:
  - Change Rip Directory
  - Change Sport
  - Copy Messages
  - Support: Access Synergy SupportWeb
  - About: Provides current details of the application
  - Logout

#### Uploads

The Upload Progress Section on the Home Screen displays a variety of information that allows you to monitor the progress of your upload.

###### Headers

- **Game ID**: A unique numeric ID used internally by Synergy to locate and identify a game
- **Upload ID**: A unique numeric ID used internally by Synergy to locate and identify a specific upload for a game
- **Upload Start Date**
- **Upload End Date**
- **League**
- **Game Date**
- **Game**
- **Rip Progress:** How far along in the Rip process the game being uploaded is. All uploads are ripped to the local hard drive (or selected location) before being uploaded to the Synergy servers. This allows an upload to be resumed where it left off if it gets interrupted.
- **Upload Progress:** in percentage
- **Upload Speed:** In MBPS
- **Angle**: Camera Angle identified during file selection
- **Type**
- **Cancel/Remove**: Click the upload in the queue to highlight and select the **Remove** button to cancel or remove an existing upload

questions.question: How can you confirm a pitch chart was uploaded for a game?
options: The Upload Complete Data File column shows a green check mark
The Upload Complete CF column is blank
questions.explanation: The Upload Complete Data File column shows a green check mark when a pitch chart has been uploaded.

questions.question: You want to remove an unwanted upload from the Transfer Status queue. What do you do?
options: Click the Gear icon and choose Logout
Click the line of the upload, then click Remove
questions.explanation: Clicking the item's line activates the Remove button.

questions.question: Your internet connection drops mid-upload. Why can the upload resume where it left off?
options: The pitch chart is uploaded first
All uploads are ripped to the local hard drive (or selected location) before going to Synergy servers
questions.explanation: Ripping to the local drive first allows an interrupted upload to resume where it stopped.

questions.question: You need to change where the Rip file is stored from the Transfer Status page. Where is that option?
options: The Gear icon settings, under Change Rip Directory
questions.explanation: The Gear icon's application settings include Change Rip Directory.
